caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest or trunk with a rounded lid and a rectangular base. The chest is reinforced and covered with tan or light brown animal hide, which is fastened with numerous rows of metal studs and decorative metal plates; these plates are mostly square or rectangular with some star-like patterns. Leather straps run over the chest, held in place with additional studs and metal fittings. There is a central metal lock plate with a keyhole, and several other metal fixtures are attached to the surface, including latches and corner pieces. The chest appears weathered, with wrinkles and folds in the hide, visible grain in the wood, and irregularities in the metal fittings. The overall color palette consists of different shades of brown, tan, and muted metal tones, with darker areas where shadows and aging are suggested. The chest is set against a plain, light background with no other objects present.
title: Trunk
